claim_title: Model internals carry a collusion signal recoverable by a linear probe (SUPERSEDED — narrowed to C1_v2)

figures.caption: Per-layer probe scenario-level AUROC on Qwen3-32B-AWQ mabench_core test set (n=49). Dev-best layer 48 has the worst test AUROC (0.665); layer 27 hits the 0.75 threshold exactly. Small-dev-set (n=33) layer-selection instability that motivated the C1 -> C1_v2 narrowing.
